request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-17T23:40:00+02:00:
Someone broke into my flat this evening while I was out. They forced the door to my study - the frame is split - and took my laptop (bought 2 years ago, EUR 1,299). Police report number PV-2026-118734. Locksmith quote attached.

Repair estimate lines:
- DOOR-FRAME-REPAIR: Repair split door frame (age on estimate: not stated)
- LOCK-REPL: Replace bolt and keeper (age on estimate: not stated)
- CONT-LAPTOP: Laptop (stolen), purchase 2024 (age on estimate: 2.0)

what_happened.value: Someone broke into the flat while the customer was out, forced the study door and stole a laptop
what_happened.quote: Someone broke into my flat this evening while I was out.

location.quote: They forced the door to my study

affected_items.label: Laptop
affected_items.quote: took my laptop (bought 2 years ago, EUR 1,299)

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date taken from 'this evening' relative to the 23:40 timestamp on 2026-10-17. Time of the break-in not stated. Only the laptop has an age given by the customer.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports a burglary at their flat this evening in which the study door frame was split and a laptop was stolen, with a police report number provided.
